answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the signal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the onyx of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
